_comment: Exchange contract metadata used ONLY by the historical backtest to reconstruct which weekly expiries were listed in the past (the live engine reads expiries from NSE's contract-info API). NIFTY weekly options expire on the weekday below; when that day is a trading holiday the expiry moves to the previous trading day. Source: NSE circulars (NIFTY weekly expiry moved from Thursday to Tuesday for contracts expiring on or after 1 Sep 2025).
